The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Two Person Team League Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

Dates: 8.16, 8.23, 8.30, 9.13, 9.20, 9.27, 10.4, 10.11

Start Times: 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM

CCA Cornhole leagues are social, laid-back, and all about having a good time. Expect a relaxed atmosphere where drinks in hand are encouraged, friendly competition is welcome, and meeting new people is part of the game. Whether you’re a seasoned bag-tosser or brand new, this league is built for you.

Season Format
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: Each team will play one of the two tournament nights with the brackets being split.

Game Format
- Standard cornhole rules

- Two-person teams

- Teams can be men’s, women’s, or co-ed

- Cancellation scoring to 21 points

- No going over 21

Weekly Play
- Teams play for 1 hour and 15 minutes each night

- Three 25-minute games per night

- Each game is Best of 3

- Games rotate through pool play, with teams facing multiple opponents each night

Two Person Team Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

Unlike traditional CCA competition leagues, you won't be competing against other participants in Rock Climbing. Instead, you will take part in training sessions with instructors, with a goal of improving your own climbing ability and the opportunity to meet new people.

Join us for a social 2v2 Euchre league centered around great cards, cold drinks, and a fun, welcoming bar atmosphere. This league is perfect for players who want to play, enjoy friendly competition, and are looking for a relaxed night out with good people and good vibes.

League Format
- Teams: 2 players per team

- Teams will face three different teams each night

- 90 minutes of play each night

- Three 30-minute games

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks
- Single-elimination format
- Tournament games are Best of 3, played within the hour

League Fee
- $48.00 per participant

Fee includes:
- One league t-shirt per participant
- All necessary equipment
- Drink specials at our sponsor bar

- League management and certified umpires

- Specials at the sponsor bar on game days and beer coupon

Join CCA Sports for well-run, high-quality, and fun indoor volleyball leagues in the Indy area! Indoor volleyball is a great way to stay active, enjoy friendly competition, and be part of a social, team-focused atmosphere.

Skill Levels
Leagues are offered for multiple experience levels:

- Recreational

- Intermediate

- Competitive

- Divisions are available on different nights throughout the year.

League Format – Six-Player Co-Ed Volleyball

- Six players per team on the court

- A minimum of 2 women must be on the court at all times 3:1 male/female ratio

- Recommended roster size: 6–9 players, no maximum

Weekly Play
- Teams play for 1 hour each night

- Each match consists of 3 sets

Set 1: 25 points

Set 2: 25 points

Set 3: 21 points

- All games count toward the standings

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks

- Single-elimination format

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirt for each participant

- Full league management and staff support

- Fun, social atmosphere throughout the season

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Two Person Team League Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

CCA is excited to bring back Golf!

The league will be held at Eagle Creek Golf Club. Each week will consist of 9 hole play with a cart. Two teams will be paired together each week and scoring will be calculated as follows:

Eagle: +5 points
Birdie: +3 points
Par: +1 point
Bogey: 0 points
Double Bogey or higher: -2 points

All of the scores will be NET with a players handicap. League play is “Best Ball”, so both players play their own ball, but only 1 score will count per hole earning one of the above point totals. If both players reach double bogey score prior to getting to the green, they can choose to pick up their balls and take the -2 points to help speed up play.

In addition to hole scores we will look to add longest drive, closest to pin, and longest putt markers each week which the winning team will be rewarded with +2 points per marker.

To help speed up play, if you lose a ball in the rough/fescue, please take a penalty stroke and drop in the vicinity of where you last saw the ball, rather than going back to tee box and re-hitting. Same rule applies to OB stakes or other hazards, please drop the ball closest to the line the ball crossed the hazard (Lateral Drop). Thank you for your cooperation with these rules.

Appropriate golf attire is required at Eagle Creek Golf Club.

Dates: 8.25, 9.1, 9.8, 9.15, 9.22, 9.29, 10.6, 10.13

Start Times: 5:30 PM

Join CCA Sports for the highest quality and most organized sand volleyball leagues in Indianapolis! With multiple nights of play and divisions for every skill level, sand volleyball is a great way to stay active, enjoy the outdoors, and be part of a fun, social league atmosphere.

Leagues are offered for a variety of experience levels:
- Recreational

The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Join CCA Sports for the highest quality and most organized sand volleyball leagues in Indianapolis! With multiple nights of play and divisions for every skill level, sand volleyball is a great way to stay active, enjoy the outdoors, and be part of a fun, social league atmosphere.

Skill Levels
Leagues are offered for a variety of experience levels:
- Recreational

- Intermediate

- Competitive

Divisions are available on different nights throughout the week.

League Format – Six’s Volleyball
- Six players per team

- A minimum of 4 players is required to start a match

- Male-to-female ratio may not exceed 3:1

(For example, 4 males and 1 female is not permitted)

- Rally scoring, following indoor 6’s volleyball rules

Weekly Play
- Teams play for 1 hour each night

- Each match consists of 3 sets

- All sets are played to 21 points

- All games count toward the standings

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks

- Single-elimination format

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Two Person Team League Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Join us for a social 2v2 Euchre league centered around great cards, cold drinks, and a fun, welcoming bar atmosphere. This league is perfect for players who want to play, enjoy friendly competition, and are looking for a relaxed night out with good people and good vibes.

League Format
- Teams: 2 players per team

- Teams will face three different teams each night

- 90 minutes of play each night

- Three 30-minute games

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks
- Single-elimination format
- Tournament games are Best of 3, played within the hour

League Fee
- $48.00 per participant

Fee includes:
- One league t-shirt per participant
- All necessary equipment
- Drink specials at our sponsor bar

Two Person Team Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

Start Times: 7:00 PM, 7:30 PM, 8:00 PM

The CCA Pickleball League is the perfect mix of fun, competition, and social play. Teams can be co-ed, all-male, or all-female, making it accessible for everyone. Whether you’re here to compete or just enjoy a fun night out with friends, Pickleball is a fast-paced, engaging way to stay active and meet other players.

League Format
- Matches last 1 hour each week

- Regular game scoring applies; sets will not be recorded

- The team with the most games won at the end of the hour wins the match

- Subs are allowed during the regular season; only rostered players may participate in the tournament

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks of weekly play

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks of single-elimination matches

- Tournament matches follow the same 1-hour match format with regular game scoring

Weekly Play

- Teams play weekly matches at designated courts (locations and times vary by season)

- Matches maximize playtime so all players get on the court regularly

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirts

- Full league support and management

- Fun, social atmosphere with opportunities to meet and play with other league participants

Two Person Team League Forfeit Policy - https://www.ccasports.com/page/two-person-forfeit-policy

Join CCA Sports for well-run, high-quality, and fun indoor volleyball leagues in the Indy area! Indoor volleyball is a great way to stay active, enjoy friendly competition, and be part of a social, team-focused atmosphere.

Skill Levels
Leagues are offered for multiple experience levels:

- Recreational

- Intermediate

- Competitive

- Divisions are available on different nights throughout the year.

League Format – Six-Player Co-Ed Volleyball

- Six players per team on the court

- A minimum of 2 women must be on the court at all times 3:1 male/female ratio

- Recommended roster size: 6–9 players, no maximum

Weekly Play
- Teams play for 1 hour each night

- Each match consists of 3 sets

Set 1: 25 points

Set 2: 25 points

Set 3: 21 points

- All games count toward the standings

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks

- Single-elimination format

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirt for each participant

- Full league management and staff support

- Fun, social atmosphere throughout the season

CCA Dodgeball is a fun and fast-paced co-ed team sport. You'll need a minimum of 10 players on your roster. During gameplay, a maximum of eight players are on the court at a time with a minimum of 3 girls playing at any time.

Games are played on indoor basketball courts. We use soft skin dodgeballs because they are easy to grip and throw hard, yet are very soft on impact.

Beginner/Social division is for teams looking to have a fun time in a less competitive environment.

Recreational division is for teams with a more competitive mindset or past experience playing in dodgeball leagues.

If you like team sports, want to try something new, think you're an undiscovered athletic wonder, or simply enjoy meeting new people—come out and play in Indy's best Dodgeball league!

Join CCA Sports for well-run, high-quality, and fun indoor volleyball leagues in the Indy area! Indoor volleyball is a great way to stay active, enjoy friendly competition, and be part of a social, team-focused atmosphere.

Skill Levels
Leagues are offered for multiple experience levels:

- Recreational

- Intermediate

- Competitive

- Divisions are available on different nights throughout the year.

League Format – Six-Player Co-Ed Volleyball

- Six players per team on the court

- A minimum of 2 women must be on the court at all times 3:1 male/female ratio

- Recommended roster size: 6–9 players, no maximum

Weekly Play
- Teams play for 1 hour each night

- Each match consists of 3 sets

Set 1: 25 points

Set 2: 25 points

Set 3: 21 points

- All games count toward the standings

Season Structure
- Regular Season: 6 weeks

- Post-Season Tournament: 1–2 weeks

- Single-elimination format

Included With Registration
- Official league team shirt for each participant

- Full league management and staff support

- Fun, social atmosphere throughout the season

Signing up for the Sub List gives you the option to fill in for a night if a team requests players, or if there are multiple subs available, a team may be created for a night. You will receive an offer that must be accepted in order to sub. Once you have subbed, your registration will be moved back to not offered so that you are eligible again to sub in a future week.

Dates: 10.25, 11.1, 11.8, 11.15, 11.22, 12.6, 12.13, 12.20

Start Times: 6:15 PM, 7:15 PM, 8:15 PM, 9:15 PM
